evals.prompt: Analise as dependências do projeto SOF. Quais tarefas estão bloqueadas e qual é o caminho crítico?
evals.expected_output: Markdown report com overview de dependências, grafo de tarefas bloqueadas, tarefas críticas, e caminho crítico identificado

assertions.name: has-dependency-graph
assertions.description: Output contains a dependency graph or visualization section

assertions.name: has-blocked-tasks-section
assertions.description: Output identifies and lists blocked tasks

assertions.name: has-critical-path
assertions.description: Output mentions or analyzes critical path

assertions.name: is-markdown-formatted
assertions.description: Output is properly formatted as Markdown

evals.prompt: Qual é o impacto de concluir SOF-123? Quantas outras tarefas seriam desbloqueadas?
evals.expected_output: Análise específica mostrando todas as tarefas que seriam desbloqueadas, com lista e sugestões de próximas ações

assertions.name: identifies-impacted-tasks
assertions.description: Output lists tasks that would be unblocked by completing SOF-123

assertions.name: quantifies-impact
assertions.description: Output provides a count or number of tasks affected

assertions.name: explains-dependencies
assertions.description: Output explains why tasks are blocked and how completion helps

assertions.name: provides-next-steps
assertions.description: Output suggests next actions after completing the task

evals.prompt: Sugira a ordem ótima de execução para o projeto para minimizar tempo bloqueado. Existem ciclos de dependência?
evals.expected_output: Recomendação de sequência de tarefas, identificação de tarefas prontas para iniciar, e alertas sobre ciclos se existirem

assertions.name: provides-execution-order
assertions.description: Output provides a recommended sequence or order for task execution

assertions.name: detects-circular-dependencies
assertions.description: Output checks for or mentions circular/cyclic dependencies

assertions.name: optimizes-for-minimization
assertions.description: Output explains how the order minimizes blocking time

assertions.name: groups-tasks-by-readiness
assertions.description: Output groups tasks by readiness (ready now vs. blocked vs. critical)

assertions.name: includes-timeline-insight
assertions.description: Output provides insight into timeline or parallelization opportunities
